title: Corsica GR-20 · Peaks along Europe's toughest trail
description: Track your ascents of the peaks along Corsica's legendary GR-20. Free app for iOS and Android.
heroTagline: Europe's hardest long-distance trail and its summits, in one challenge.
whatIsParagraphs: The GR-20 traverses Corsica from north to south along the island's mountainous spine. It's roughly 180 km with 10,000–12,000 metres of cumulative ascent — widely considered Europe's toughest long-distance trail.

This challenge collects the main summits you brush past or attack from the GR-20 itself: Monte Cinto, Paglia Orba, Monte Rotondo and company. You don't need to walk the full trail to tick off the peaks.
With the app you carry the list on your phone, log each ascent with a photo and date, and watch your progress grow without spreadsheets.

faqs.q: What's the highest peak in Corsica?
Do I need to hike the whole GR-20?
faqs.a: No. You can attack the peaks one at a time from side approaches; the challenge is about the summits, not the trail.
June to September. In winter the Corsican ridge carries snow and ice.
